title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode10 The Strange and the Talented

meta.Episode: Episode10 — The Strange and the Talented

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see where you're going with this script.
Pegasus Odyssey is an orthodox heroic epic.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist, Prince Pegasus, embarks on a journey to slay the demon lord who has been causing great suffering to the people of his kingdom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Pegasus finds new allies on his travels. His first great deed is saving a village from a terrifying dragon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Many adventures later, the prince duels the demon lord. He prevails and returns to his town as a hero.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, I have some ideas for this play.
Would you like to hear them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you already have something? Tell me, then, I'm curious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to emphasize the hardships the prince must suffer on his journey to make the audience sympathize with him more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm, yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think some lightning strikes would be excellent for this purpose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm, yes... No, hold on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Zippy zaps! That's sooo cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right? I brought along this plasma generator—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait a minute! Why do you even have a gizmo like that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I thought it might come in handy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who'd think that, ever?! Not to mention this must be incredibly dangerous!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry, the device can be securely attached to the stage in a way that will keep the audience perfectly safe. Please make sure you don't touch it or you'll die.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What about keeping ME safe?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: And so it starts again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What does?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: When Rui gets excited about an idea for a show, he just has to try it out.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He tried suspending classmates from ropes in the school gym, or holding them underwater in the pool...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Everyone soon regrets signing up to do shows with him and starts to avoid him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But why? It all sounds fun to me!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Maybe that's the problem, that there aren't more people as enthusiastic as you are, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not going to risk my life on-stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you said you'd perform any role I gave you to, quote, “12,000%”, unquote!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm afraid that I have no choice but to step down as a stage director. Nene, good luck working with these people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whaaat? We won't be doing the zippy zaps?
But lightning bolts on stage would easily be the highlight of our play!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Highlight?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm. I can see how they would make it an electrifying performance in more ways than one... It would be an unprecedented spectacle, sure to draw attention.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then we'd have lots and lots of people coming to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ngh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui...
If it's just a few little lightning bolts, maybe we could give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not because an electric show like that would make me famous! But I think that innovation is key to excellent theater!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... Well, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about also adding some realism to the dragon fight scene by means of a modified flamethrower?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A...flamethrower?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The final battle with the demon lord could be made more epic if you were launched ten meters into the air before landing to deliver the final blow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've recently constructed a powerful air jet which can be installed in the stage floor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you have any suggestions that AREN'T extremely hazardous?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
B-But... They would certainly wow the audience.
As a true star, I should be able to rise to the challenge!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yaaay! All of these ideas are amazing!
Do you have any more?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, since this is an outdoor stage, we could construct a waterfall...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Don't encourage him or he'll get out of control...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... We had so much to talk about, it took up the entire day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We'll meet here tomorrow at 7:00AM!
Check before you leave that you haven't forgotten your staff cards!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Robo-Nene
rows.Line: See you tomorrow!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I haven't seen you in such a good mood in a while.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Who, me? I'm always in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, I'm heading the other way. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh? You're not going home yet?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No. I need to buy some more parts for modding some stage equipment. I have my work cut out for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
.....
He really seems happy.
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Interesting. I thought all that was remarkable about you was the size of your ego, but you're not too bad at acting and dance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that was passable, but this style of fighting seems too bland for Prince Pegasus. You need to use your whole body to make it more expressive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll try it another way... How about now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's much better movement, but it only makes the other areas you're lacking in more apparent.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... I'm spent!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? So soon?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh! I've hired a tyrannical director...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: What's the problem, “future super-star”? Was that the best you could do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, of course not!
But I wish you gave me some hints on how to improve...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! I know where we could go for ideas!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes? And where would that be?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku's SEKAI! I have this song on my phone, “Untitled,” that I can play to take us there instantly!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You have “Untitled” on your phone too?!
You're seriously suggesting we go to that crazy place again?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It just appeared on my phone before I knew it!
Tsukasa, let's introduce Rui and Robo-Nene to Miku and KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! Stop! I don't wanna go!
